title: Area-code shard C pass 17 — 512 / 515 / 518
summary: Bounded shard-C area-code enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 512, 515, and 518 with public-role person cross-enumeration.

provenance.method: bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration with public-role person cross-enumeration

data.research_question: Which current public organizations, communications surfaces, and publicly identifiable organizational-role people can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 512, 515, and 518?
data.method: Current NANPA geographic admission, deterministic NPA mod 3 == 2 sharding, literal and locality-derived public-source searches, historical-directory discovery only, current-status verification, repository dedupe, public identifier enumeration, and public-role person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational role, participation, proximity, attendance, volunteering, or membership.
Do not merge people or organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Person-org relations in this pass are explicit public organizational roles; weak cases were not promoted.

findings.notes: Austin Mutual Aid and Monkeywrench Books retained as current. Austin Mutual Aid exposes Linktree, Instagram, Facebook-group, volunteer, contact and payment surfaces. Monkeywrench is a current all-volunteer radical bookstore/social hub with @monkeywrenchatx; it is not relabeled anarchist.
Des Moines Mutual Aid is currently self-described as an abolitionist mutual-aid collective. The Supply Hive is a current mutual-aid/social-justice nonprofit with named founders and board leadership.

Albany Food Not Bombs is current and exposes Linktree, Instagram, Bluesky, X, email-list and public Discord volunteer surfaces. Hudson/Catskill Housing Coalition has current 2026 Albany mutual-aid food distributions and first-party co-founder/board-chair evidence for Shirle Cross.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization enumeration pass with public-role person cross-enumeration
